identity_note: Dirty shared worktree. Existing UI-06 TimelinePages and SegmentCache changes are retained; frontend agent did not modify their files or timeline_pages.mjs.

annotation_editor_before.method: An isolated adjacent fixture contains git show HEAD:.../AnnotationEditor.tsx; the real component is never replaced. Temporary fixture/test are removed in finally.

regressions.elf_before: Cached-timeline symbol refresh test fails before adding refreshSymbols; passes afterward. Two additional tests reject an Attach completed after workspace or projection replacement.

An earlier annotation read replaces the saved comment
argv: refreshes cached timeline symbols|keeps a late annotation save|keeps a saved comment

before.method: Actual Chromium UI with authenticated Rust E2E service. 200% zoom uses half-sized CSS viewport and deviceScaleFactor=2; it does not test WebKit or OS scaling.

after.method: Actual Chromium UI with authenticated Rust E2E service. 200% zoom uses half-sized CSS viewport and deviceScaleFactor=2; it does not test WebKit or OS scaling.

evidence.method: 50 actual Chromium result clicks against the retained Xiaomi Flight capture and authenticated release Rust service. Register DOM timing includes transport, concurrent selection requests, React, DOM checks, and browser automation; ui_ms additionally waits for the detail key. No baseline speedup is claimed.

closed_workspace.note: Closed workspace rejects further reads; Arc release is covered separately by the Rust replay lifecycle test.

call_tree_interactions.method: Actual CallTreePane in Chromium with synthetic bounded page responses. Deep chain=512; wide roots=10,000. No Rust IPC or backend tree-build cost is claimed.

heap.note: After includes a page reload and root replacement; it is diagnostic, not a retained-cache limit.

flight_interactions.method: Actual Chromium interactions against the retained Xiaomi Flight capture and authenticated release Rust service. Covers summaries, report/single-artifact context, >2,000 real results, cross-page hits, empty results, and a delayed real response across workspace replacement.
checks: report context equals retained report; missing profile remains unavailable
instruction, memory, semantic, and discontinuity summaries match actual rendered accessible rows and typed details
real >2,000 matches: next/previous pages and hits cross page 1/2 in both directions
empty result keeps navigation disabled
delayed real results response cannot change replacement workspace or add a stale error
same retained artifact opens without fabricated session context and remains queryable

summaries.summary: transfer/call: source=0x7bea73904c target=0x7e9a37021c x0=0x3e8 x1=0x2 x2=0x4 x3=0x0 x8=0x0

picker_fixture.note: Copied retained Flight at the fixed single-artifact picker path; session JSON is unchanged, and both API artifact digests must match the original.

elf_interactions.method: Actual Chromium Attach ELF, Resolve symbol, and automatic timeline refresh within the existing projection against the authenticated Rust service and a fixed valid AArch64 ELF fixture. No API response mocks.
checks: real Attach ELF and Resolve symbol show native_work from the verified fixture
automatic refresh uses the existing projection and same stable event key without changing captured location or summary
wrong module digest is refused and the previously verified symbols remain usable

error.detail: symbol.module_identity_mismatch: ELF digest does not match module identity

limitations: Chromium on current Linux host only. 200% layout uses half CSS viewport and DPR=2; no Tauri WebKit, native browser zoom, OS scaling, or screen-reader audit.

902.2 ms p95 register DOM timing includes browser automation, authenticated loopback transport, concurrent detail work, React and DOM assertions. 922.6 ms p95 UI timing also waits for the detail key. Neither is a baseline speedup or pure IPC number.

Call-tree 512-depth/10,000-width test uses actual CallTreePane with synthetic bounded pages; Rust first full-tree construction, real IPC bytes, and replay Arc release are proven separately by the parent service tests.
Flight single-artifact picker proof uses copies of the retained 67,108,864-byte Flight at the fixed main.trace.bin picker path. Session JSON and captured SHA identity remain unchanged.
Production readiness waits for Vite stdout with strictPort because a closed IPv4-port readiness probe silently stalls on this host.
next: No frontend implementation or acceptance run remains in this assigned scope. Parent integrates independent Rust first-build, IPC and replay lifecycle evidence.

service_identities.relationship_note: Parent root reported the later rebuild changes only checked-u32 metadata test entry, unit-test placement and formatting, and preserves the c32 product path. The 50-click timing is attributed to c32; four retained capture browser checks use 3cce8666. No latency equivalence is inferred from the functional rerun.

retained_capture_browser.note: Script and scenarios copied unchanged into the new directory because __dirname owns outputs; original evidence remains untouched.

evidence.method: Actual Chromium UI and Rust production service behind the existing authenticated E2E loopback transport; no response mocks or product-code changes.
